title: qos/01000ms.png shift = the honest critical pipe-pressure halo (lanes at the E9 bound from ~tick 8), but it is missing from the spec's per-demo re-bless cause list
location: goldens/qos/01000ms.png (c3.patch: Binary files a/goldens/qos/01000ms.png ... differ, 41451 -> 42082 bytes); cause list at spec-4-1-warning-forecast.md 'Golden' section

Spec cause list: "Re-bless = ALL `.t1`/`.log.bin` (catalog_hash fold — mechanical, cause-documented) + T2s that shift (a demo that strains at a capture gains rings/halos: sla + qos_contention (the saturated router row), qos_emphasis (era-3 load), qos.dem's 65 s capture (the panel + surge strain), lose.dem (its own stuck packet...)". Pixel diff of old vs new (PIL): 8996 changed px, all in band y 355-525 x 356-913; NEW colors: (232, 69, 69) x4506, (232, 155, 140) x1867, (227, 108, 55) x1163 — exactly state_critical: app/render/palette.odin "p.state_critical = jcol(obj, "state_critical", {232, 69, 69, 255})" with halo alpha 110 (view.odin "halo.a = 110"). Honesty math: qos.dem era 3 spawns 6 packets/tick (demand.json email volume 4 + streaming volume 2) vs bundle drain <= 15 u/tick (bundle_cap, packet_bandwidth 30) -> lanes pin at lane_queue_packets 6 = 180 u = 100% -> Red (warnings.odin strain_level(press*100/lane_bound_units, 70, 90)). No top-right (panel) change at 1 s: diff x-max 913 < panel x 1030; forecast window opens at start-lead = 1200-600 = tick 600 (demand.json streaming_surge). 65000ms.png diff = panel region y 0-53 x 1030-1279 + same halo band.
detail: The 1 s frame is NOT a no-strain frame: qos is at its E9 bound by ~tick 8, so the critical halo is honest and harness-verified (14/14 demos green at the sha). The spec cause list names only qos.dem's 65 s capture, leaving the 1 s shift unenumerated — a cause-doc gap, not a behavior defect.
recommended_fix: Add to the spec's golden cause list: qos.dem's 01000ms capture gains the critical pipe-pressure halo (lanes at the E9 bound from ~tick 8; spawn 6/tick vs <=15 u/tick drain). No code change.
